source_summary: Tall Chinese landscape with layered blue-green rocky mountains, cascading streams, pine and bamboo groves, winding river flats, and small scholar figures; calligraphy, seals, borders, and plain paper areas are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: distant_mist_mountains
motifs.description: Soft background mountain silhouettes across the upper distance, including the left cropped cliff, central muted triangular peak, and low right ridges emerging from pale mist.

motifs.name: upper_left_crag_cluster
motifs.description: Large blue-green rocky mountain cluster on the upper left with stacked crags, rounded boulders, dark vegetation dots, and ochre rock seams.
must_preserve: vertical cliff striations and broken rock planes

motifs.name: upper_right_bamboo_cliffs
motifs.description: Right-side upper hillside and cliff group with pale green slopes, dark shrub caps, vertical bamboo or slender pines, and a narrow pale waterfall-like cleft.
must_preserve: narrow white falling-water cleft and misty edges

motifs.name: central_cascading_stream_gorge
motifs.description: Central descending stream system winding through rocks, including multiple small waterfalls, white water channels, scalloped current lines, and flanking boulders.
must_preserve: small dark moss clusters along stream edges

motifs.name: middle_left_conifer_bank
motifs.description: Dense stand of tall, thin conifers on the middle-left riverbank, backed by pale hills and a broad horizontal water surface.
must_preserve: dark needle clusters at tree tops
fine reed-like strokes at the base

motifs.name: middle_right_wooded_river_bend
motifs.description: Middle-right wooded bend with rounded blue-green hills, dense dark tree canopies, exposed ochre rock faces, and winding stream channels between them.
motifs.role: middle-ground wooded island and river bend
must_preserve: irregular shrub silhouettes along ridge tops

motifs.name: lower_left_gnarled_pine_group
motifs.description: Large foreground-left pine group with twisting trunks, drooping branches, dark needle masses, and smaller companion trees rising from a green bank.
must_preserve: dark base shadows and surrounding low shrubs

motifs.name: lower_scholars_and_lone_pine
motifs.description: Lower riverbank scene with two small scholar figures standing on pale ground near a tall sparse pine and low shrubs, set against calm water lines.
must_preserve: tall slender pine trunk with flat canopy
pale bank wash and surrounding water ripples

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
